epidemic.zh: 流行病、（傳染病的）大流行

ex.en: Thousands upon thousands have died from the epidemic.
ex.zh: 成千上萬的人死於這場傳染病。

ex.en: Health officials are working to stop the epidemic.
ex.zh: 衛生官員正努力遏止疫情。

ex.en: Obesity has become an epidemic in many countries.
ex.zh: 肥胖已經成為許多國家普遍的問題。

ex.en: There is an epidemic of fake news online.
She has a degree in epidemiology.
Epidemiology helps us understand how diseases spread.
ex.zh: 流行病學幫助我們了解疾病如何傳播。

ex.en: I've only seen the first episode.
Seriously though, episode 21 made me almost cry while laughing.
ex.zh: 說真的，第 21 集讓我笑到差點哭出來。

ex.en: That reminds me of a Spongebob episode.
ex.zh: 這讓我想起一集《海綿寶寶》。

ex.en: It was a painful episode in her life.
ex.zh: 那是她人生中一段痛苦的經歷。

ex.en: He doesn't like to talk about that episode.
